cohort: Same four roster pairs, straight 6 yd/s or live evasion from 6 yd/s, five geometries, both mirrors, 30 repetitions/cell; 2,400 per revision. One FS pursuer; no NFL claim or guaranteed feasibility for every geometry.

definitions.yards: Offensive possession gain from the starting point; lost fumbles end at the offensive fumble spot, never the defensive return spot. Raw physical plays including fouls.
definitions.attempt: Any observed tackle bond, hit, missed tackle or broken tackle against an offensive carrier. Observe bonds each tick because older engines omit low-impact wrap events.
definitions.untouchedTd: Offensive touchdowns with no observed tackle attempt; may include non-tackle body bumps.
definitions.readyRangeTicks: Pre-integration 20 Hz samples of free, standing, ready defenders inside body radii + arm reach. May be occluded; not guaranteed tackle opportunities.
definitions.firstContactGain: Engine firstContactX. Baseline includes whiffs; updated engine excludes whiffs and includes body impacts. Definitions differ; not an NFL event or directly comparable contact metric.
definitions.trace: First repetition per cell, sampled every 0.5 s. No extra behavior calls or RNG draws.
